title: HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to insurance requirements for homeless service providers, fiscal impacts of insurance costs and related…
text:
[Council File 26-1285]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to insurance requirements for homeless service providers, fiscal impacts of insurance costs and related matters.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Jurado - Soto-Martinez):
INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO), Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and Los Angeles Housing Department to report on insurance requirements for homeless service providers, including a review of City actions that may impact the ability of service providers to effectively provide support to the City, fiscal impacts of insurance costs and City policies impacting costs, and other relevant policies, legislation, or actions that involve insurance impacts on the homeless service sector.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion asking for a review of the insurance rules that homeless service providers must meet, including what those insurance costs add to their budgets.
